name: Look
description: A colour grade in linear light: white balance, then a brightness lift that keeps white, contrast around mid grey and saturation, blended in by strength.

params.label: Look strength
params.doc: How much of the grade is applied, from the picture as it is at 0 to the full grade at 100.

params.label: Brightness
params.doc: Lifts the midtones while white stays white; 100 leaves them as they are.

params.label: Saturation
params.doc: The picture's colour, from grey at 0 to the picture's own at 100.

params.label: White balance (K)
params.doc: Colour temperature: lower is warmer, 6500 is neutral.

params.label: Contrast
params.doc: Contrast around mid grey; 100 leaves it as it is.
